test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct related to eco-system?

(i) Food we eat is digested by various enzymes in our body.

(ii) Enzyme is specific in their action.

(iii) Specific enzymes are needed for the breakdown of a particular substance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The food we eat is digested by various enzymes in our body, which are biological catalysts.
 
• Enzymes are highly specific in their action, meaning each enzyme only acts on a particular substrate.
 
• Specific enzymes are required for the breakdown of particular substances; for example, amylase breaks down starch
